title: Tests that repeat each other or their module's own code
body:
- `wire.rs`: `every_*_message_survives_encoding_and_decoding` is the `split = len` case of `*_messages_decode_when_the_bytes_split_at_any_offset`. `encode_viewer` and `encode_server`, and `drain_viewer` and `drain_server`, are identical pairs. `a_complete_message_whose_fds_have_not_arrived_is_an_error` and `a_buffer_with_fewer_fds_queued_than_planes_is_an_error` assert `MissingFds` from the same path.
- `save.rs`: the tests build `toml::to_string(&File { version: VERSION, .. })` four times beside the same build in `save()`.
- `panes.rs`: four tests repeat `Font::load(14.0)`, `Scene::new`, draw, collect texts.
- `scratch.rs` and `save.rs`: both spawn `sh -c`, poll 100 times at 20 ms, then kill and wait. `first_child` in `scratch.rs` repeats the children read in `shell_cwd`.
- `compositor.rs`: `crossed` has a four-assert test on `u32 <`.

About 100 lines.
